LanguageData.LP_AB_LostRelic.label: commission heirloom
LanguageData.LP_AB_LostRelic.description: A family heirloom lost by the client, guarded by a gang. Bring it back to the colony (on the colony map or carried by a colonist) to complete the commission; the heirloom is returned to the client.
LanguageData.LP_AB_UndeadSource.label: undead source
LanguageData.LP_AB_UndeadSource.description: A black obelisk seeping with death; the dead nearby cannot rest because of it. Destroy it and the haunted ruins will grow quiet.
